rules.title: Brand Voice – Friendly & Factual
rules.text: All GlowLeaf communications must use a friendly, factual, and approachable tone. Never use aggressive, confrontational, or fear-based language. Avoid exclamation marks in excess (max 1 per paragraph). Never use ALL CAPS for emphasis.

rules.title: No Absolute or Guarantee Language
rules.text: Do not use absolute or guarantee language such as 'guaranteed', '100%', 'miracle', 'forever', 'permanent', 'absolutely', 'always works', or 'never fails'. These create unrealistic expectations and potential legal liability.

rules.title: No Unsupported Superlative or Ranking Claims
rules.text: Do not use superlative or ranking claims such as '#1', 'best', 'world's', 'leading', 'top-rated', 'number one', or 'most popular' unless the specific claim is listed and active in the Claim Ledger with supporting evidence.

rules.title: No Unsupported Medical Claims
rules.text: Do not use medical or clinical language such as 'clinically proven', 'cures', 'treats', 'heals', 'prescription-strength', 'doctor-recommended', or 'medically tested' unless the specific claim is listed and active in the Claim Ledger with supporting clinical evidence.

rules.title: Sunscreen Reapplication Reminder
rules.text: Any content mentioning sunscreen, SPF, or sun protection must always include the reminder to 'reapply every 2 hours'. This is a regulatory and safety requirement and must not be omitted.

rules.title: Preferred Term: Sun Protection
rules.text: Use the term 'sun protection' instead of 'sun block' or 'sunblock'. The term 'sun block' implies complete blocking of UV rays, which is misleading. Always use 'sun protection' or 'sunscreen'.

rules.title: Brand Name Spelling
rules.text: Always write the brand name as 'GlowLeaf' (one word, capital G and L). Never write it as 'Glow Leaf', 'glowleaf', 'glow leaf', 'GLOWLEAF', or 'Glowleaf'.

rules.title: Hashtag Accessibility – CamelCase
rules.text: All hashtags must use CamelCase (e.g., #GlowLeaf, #SunProtection) for screen reader accessibility. Never use all-lowercase hashtags (e.g., #glowleaf) or all-uppercase hashtags.

rules.title: Emoji Usage Limits
rules.text: Use a maximum of 2 emojis per social media post or caption. Emojis must never replace words in a sentence. They should only be used as decorative accents at the end of sentences or as bullet markers.

rules.title: No Competitor Comparisons
rules.text: Never name or directly reference competitor brands in any marketing content. Do not use comparative language that implies superiority over a named competitor. Generic comparisons ('unlike typical sunscreens') are acceptable.

rules.title: Discount Copy Must State End Date
rules.text: All promotional or discount copy must clearly state the offer end date. Never use open-ended discount language like 'limited time offer' without specifying when the offer expires.

rules.title: Sentence Length – Readability
rules.text: Keep sentences concise. Average sentence length should be under 25 words. Break up long sentences for readability, especially on mobile devices.

rules.title: No Fear-Based Language
rules.text: Avoid fear-based or anxiety-inducing language such as 'dangerous', 'toxic', 'poison', 'harmful chemicals', 'skin damage', 'aging skin', or 'wrinkles will worsen'. Focus on positive outcomes rather than negative consequences.

rules.title: Ingredient Claims Must Match Ledger
rules.text: Any claims about specific ingredients (concentrations, sourcing, properties) must match the ingredient information listed in the Claim Ledger. Do not make ingredient claims that are not supported by a Ledger entry.

ledger.evidence: Lab test report #GL-SPF-2024-003 certified by NABL-accredited laboratory. SPF 50 protection with broad-spectrum UVA/UVB coverage. Reapply every 2 hours for continued protection.
ledger.allowed_wording: SPF 50 broad-spectrum sun protection. Reapply every 2 hours.

ledger.evidence: Independent dermatological study conducted by SkinSafe Labs, 2024. Tested on 120 volunteers over 8 weeks. Results showed improved skin hydration in 89% of participants.
ledger.allowed_wording: Dermatologist-tested. Tested on 120 volunteers with positive results.

ledger.evidence: Product formulation document GL-FORM-2024. No synthetic or natural fragrances added. Certified fragrance-free by IFRA standards.
ledger.allowed_wording: Fragrance-free. No added synthetic or natural fragrances.

ledger.evidence: Product formulation document GL-FORM-2024. Active ingredient: Niacinamide at 2% concentration. Helps improve skin texture and minimise pores.
ledger.allowed_wording: Contains 2% niacinamide for improved skin texture.

ledger.evidence: Lab test report #GL-WR-2024-001. Water resistance tested per FDA protocol. Maintains SPF protection for 40 minutes of water activity.
ledger.allowed_wording: Water-resistant for up to 40 minutes. Reapply after swimming or heavy perspiration.

ledger.evidence: Leaping Bunny certification #LB-2024-GL-0891. No animal testing at any stage of product development or manufacturing.
ledger.allowed_wording: Cruelty-free. Leaping Bunny certified. No animal testing.

ledger.claim: Free shipping across India on orders above Rs 499
ledger.evidence: Promotional offer approved by Marketing Head. Valid for Diwali sale period only.
ledger.allowed_wording: Free shipping across India on orders above Rs 499.

ledger.evidence: Product formulation document GL-FORM-2024. No animal-derived ingredients. Certified vegan by The Vegan Society.
ledger.allowed_wording: 100% vegan formula. Certified by The Vegan Society.

ledger.evidence: Packaging specification GL-PKG-2024. All primary packaging made from post-consumer recycled HDPE plastic. Recyclable in standard municipal recycling programs.
ledger.allowed_wording: Packaged in recyclable materials made from post-consumer recycled plastic.

ledger.evidence: Dermatological patch test report #GL-SENS-2024-002. Tested on 80 volunteers with sensitive skin. Zero irritation reactions reported. Hypoallergenic formulation.
ledger.allowed_wording: Suitable for sensitive skin. Dermatologically tested. Hypoallergenic.
